risk_coverage: Prevented Sowing / Planting Risk (Deficit rainfall or adverse season)
Mid-Season Adversity (Severe drought, dry spell, flood, unseasonal rains)
Post-Harvest Losses (Up to 14 days after harvest for crops left in 'cut & spread' condition in field for drying against cyclonic & unseasonal rains)
Localized Calamities (Hailstorm, landslide, inundation, cloud burst, natural fire)

critical_deadlines.intimation_period: Strictly within 72 hours of localized calamity or post-harvest event
intimation_channels: Nearest PACS Secretary / District Agriculture Office / Insurance Company Nodal Bank

required_claim_evidence: Photographs/videos of damaged farm with geotag timestamp via Crop Insurance App
Kisan Credit Card / Policy Number / Aadhaar Number
